title: Serious SSR issues with Moving Objects
body:
### Tested versions

Caused by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111210

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21043.5001) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-10105F CPU @ 3.70GHz (8 threads) - 15.87 GiB memory

### Issue description

I noticed this bug was not being tracked from my Comment on the original PR, so I'm opening it now.
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111210#issuecomment-3418554715

Here's a couple of videos of this appearing in a Production setting (excuse the extremely low bitrate)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/28ed2958-b462-4c2d-a38c-4cb736d36361

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a951f940-d6c3-4629-bb25-d70d61caae2e

Observe the engines to the left and right and notice the odd light movement, that is caused by SSR during motion, an issue not present in SSR before the PR.
This is highly distracting even in Real world scenarios

It's especially clear what's causing this in the 2nd video where I'm accelerating and decelerating back and forth, and it makes SSR a completely unusable feature for shipping.

### Steps to reproduce

Have visually distinct objects move in reflective surfaces, Emissive materials make it especially obvious.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[ssr.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28007337/ssr.zip)
